\subsubsection{Statistical analysis}

With 5 seeds per aggregator, the 95\% CIs (radii 0.0015--0.0032) overlap across a best-to-worst spread of 0.0020: no statistically supported ranking is claimed. The concatenation oracle's zero variance across seeds is flagged [REQUIRES CONFIRMATION]. Runtime cells are single timed calls.

\subsubsection{Scientific findings}

\paragraph{F-E10-01.} Final SSIM is statistically indistinguishable across all four server aggregators (spread 0.0020 vs CI radii 0.0015-0.0032 over 5 seeds). Numerical evidence: E10\_DF recorded table. Interpretation: The federation quality is robust to the server clustering implementation at this scale; k-means default is sufficient.. Limitations: n=5 seeds, one scene, one (N, K\_global, tau) operating point.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp10-aggregator-rounds}, Table~\ref{tab:exp10-final-ssim}.

\paragraph{F-E10-02.} Subspace-parsimonious aggregation lowers dictionary coherence (0.7787 vs 0.8990-0.9707) without improving final SSIM. Numerical evidence: E10\_DF coherence column vs SSIM column. Interpretation: Coherence is not a sufficient proxy for reconstruction quality in this regime.. Limitations: Surrogate implementation of the Ampeliotis-style aggregator (documented in-code).. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp10-aggregator-rounds}, Table~\ref{tab:exp10-final-ssim}.

\paragraph{F-E10-03.} Server aggregation runtime grows with K\_global and differs by aggregator (single timed calls; indicative). Numerical evidence: E10\_RUNTIME\_DF + figure (pool = OMP bases of the group). Interpretation: Server cost is measurable but secondary; no repetition-based interval is available. [REQUIRES CONFIRMATION] for timing claims.. Limitations: One timed call per (aggregator, K); no warm-up protocol.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp10-aggregator-runtime}, Table~\ref{tab:exp10-runtime}.
